claims.claim_text: Directed control-plane architecture for a production agentic AI platform, establishing a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows across multi-agent orchestration contracts and L0 route-policy dispatch.
Drove CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization by aligning generative-AI workflows and consumption-based licensing to executive revenue priorities.
Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows through evaluation gates, telemetry instrumentation, and rollback controls governing production agentic execution.
Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through production monitoring, compressing the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks for client deployments.
Architected distributed cloud and data execution infrastructure on AWS and Databricks Lakehouse, establishing high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms.
Converted bespoke delivery into reusable platform IP while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28, advancing agentic platform productization and an operating model for agentic AI.
